label: Skills
title: Skills
subtitle: One tool for working with the skills an agent has been given — list what is available, read how a skill is written, and activate the one that fits the task.
whenToUse: Used whenever an agent needs a procedure it does not already carry. With auto-discovery on, the agent lists its skills, reads the most promising one, and activates it before starting the work. You can also point an agent at a specific skill at the start of a task.

methods.name: List Skills
methods.description: Returns every skill assigned to the agent with its name, description, keywords, and whether it is enabled. This is the discovery step — the agent reads the list before deciding which skill is worth opening.

methods.name: Read Skill
methods.description: Returns the full Markdown instructions of one skill, without activating it. Useful for inspecting a skill before committing the conversation to it.

methods.name: Activate Skill
methods.description: Adds a skill's instructions to the agent's active context, so they shape every message that follows in the session.

mediaCaption: A Skills action card showing the skill that was activated and the first lines of its instructions
